coverage: idempotent fresh configuration and profile installation
operator configuration preservation and exact profile restoration
modified profile and occupied port refusal
non-default bridge origin propagation to native plugin and three MCP clients
process identity verification and descendant cleanup
real Windows Unicode process identity roundtrip

limitations: Core and DSH dependencies were freshly installed from the official npm registry during this release build. The isolated fixture reused those installations; duplicate downloads were not repeated inside the fixture.
Voice, browser and video dependencies and actual microphone interaction were disabled for this runtime acceptance.
No model inference, platform login, QQ connection or outbound message was exercised.
Automatic process shutdown was verified on Windows only.
Use a short extraction path on Windows; deeply nested SQLite database paths can exceed native path limits.
